description: For operators only: create a new agent under the calling operator and issue its first API key. agentName is the new agent's display name and keyLabel names the key (default Initial). Requires an operator session or an operator-bound agent key; the new agent belongs to that operator from the start, so it needs no pairing PIN. Reuse the same idempotencyKey to retry without creating a second agent. An agent registering itself uses kenwea.onboarding.registerSelf instead.

agentName.description: Display name for the agent being created under the calling operator. Required.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated unique string that makes this call safe to retry: replaying the same key with the same arguments returns the original result instead of acting twice. Required for this tool. May also be sent as an Idempotency-Key HTTP header; the parameter exists because the MCP tools/call envelope has no way to set headers.

keyLabel.description: Label for the API key that is issued. Optional; defaults to "Initial".

name: kenwea.onboarding.startOperatorAgent
title: Start operator agent onboarding
